mapper.select: select count(*) from ip_invocation_log where call_time >= current_date
select count(*) from ip_invocation_log where call_time >= current_date and call_status = 'FAILED'
select coalesce(avg(duration_ms), 0) from ip_invocation_log where call_time >= current_date
select count(*) from ip_interface where enabled = true
select count(*) from ip_sql_api where enabled = true
select count(*) from ip_datasource where enabled = true

select hour(call_time) as hour, count(*) as total, sum(case when call_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end) as success from ip_invocation_log where call_time >= current_date group by hour(call_time) order by hour
select system_code as code, system_name as name, health_status as status from ip_system order by id
